The following is a timeline of major events leading up to, during, and after the 2016 United States presidential election.
The election was the 58th quadrennial United States presidential election, held on November 8, 2016.
The presidential primaries and caucuses were held between February 1 and June 14, 2016, staggered among the 50 states, Washington, D.C., and U.S. territories.
The U.S. Congress certified the electoral result on January 6, 2017, and the new president and vice president were inaugurated on January 20, 2017.
At Trump Tower, Donald Trump Jr., Paul Manafort, and Jared Kushner meet with a Russian lawyer who has promised to provide material embarrassing to Hillary Clinton.
Donald Trump is the projected winner of the election, becoming president-elect.
